title: Create EditNotesSheet
description: Add a dedicated SwiftUI sheet view for editing shopping-list notes using a `NavigationStack`, `TextEditor`, and Cancel/Save toolbar actions over a local editable state copy.
acceptance_criteria: A new `EditNotesSheet` view exists and presents a `NavigationStack` titled `Notes`.
The sheet uses a `TextEditor` bound to local state seeded from the current notes value.
Toolbar actions include `Cancel` to dismiss without persisting and `Save` to commit the edited notes through injected state/callbacks.
The editor uses `.font(.body)`, hides the default scroll background, applies subtle form-consistent styling, and exposes an accessibility label for editing notes for the current list.

handoff_summary.completed: Created `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/EditNotesSheet.swift` with: `NavigationStack` titled "Notes", `TextEditor` bound to local `@State` seeded via `init(initialNotes:listName:onSave:)`, Cancel/Save toolbar items (`.cancellationAction`/`.confirmationAction`), `.font(.body)`, `.scrollContentBackground(.hidden)`, padding for form-consistent visual style, an `.accessibilityLabel("Editing notes for \(listName)")`, `@FocusState` auto-focus on appear, and a `handleSave()` that calls the `onSave` callback then dismisses. Ran `xcodegen generate` and verified a clean build.
handoff_summary.remaining: A downstream bead must wire `EditNotesSheet` into `ShoppingListDetailView` — adding the `@State var showEditNotes = false` toggle, a trigger (toolbar button or tap on the notes header), the `.sheet` presentation, and the `onSave` handler that writes the updated notes back to the document and persists via `ShoppingListFiles`.
handoff_summary.risks: None. The new file is additive and does not touch any existing source.
handoff_summary.next_action: Wire `EditNotesSheet` into `ShoppingListDetailView`: add a trigger (e.g. toolbar edit button in the notes section), present the sheet with `.sheet(isPresented:)`, and implement the `onSave` closure to update `document.notes` and persist via `ShoppingListFiles`.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: The downstream integration bead will modify `ShoppingListDetailView.swift`, which is a high-traffic file. Any other in-flight bead touching `ShoppingListDetailView.swift` should be serialised with the integration bead.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed `EditItemSheet` value-semantics pattern: accepts `initialNotes: String` + `listName: String` + `onSave: (String) -> Void` rather than a `@Binding` to the full document. This keeps the sheet decoupled from the document model and testable in isolation. `TextEditor` is placed directly inside `NavigationStack` (not inside a `Form`) so it fills the available space naturally; padding is applied manually for visual consistency.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests in this bead scope. The tester agent should verify: sheet presents correctly, Cancel discards edits, Save calls onSave with the edited text, accessibility label is set, and TextEditor auto-focuses on appear.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The sheet does not disable the Save button when notes are unchanged — this is intentional to avoid premature UX complexity; the downstream integration bead can add that if desired.

conflict_risks: The downstream integration bead will modify `ShoppingListDetailView.swift`, which is a high-traffic file. Any other in-flight bead touching `ShoppingListDetailView.swift` should be serialised with the integration bead.
